description.value: Tlall Conservancy is a protected area on the east side of Graham Island, Haida Gwaii, encompassing the Tlell River watershed and a 350-hectare fen and marsh area known as the Tlell Pontoons. It features the Anvil Trail, a 5 km loop through old-growth Sitka spruce, western redcedar, and hemlock forests along the Tlell River. The conservancy is part of an archipelago-wide system of protected areas and supports notable bird species including sandhill crane and trumpeter swan.
